page.overview:
Who is Dancing Couple?

The Dancing Couple first appear in Castle Town when Link is a child, where they can be seen in the market dancing and complimenting each other with words of affection. They can later be found at Kakariko Village behind the Windmill after Ganondorf invades Hyrule, where they will call Link annoying for invading their personal space.
